independentOriginalSpotChecks.actualScope: Fresh actual LOC PDF text: title/GPO 1937 imprint, printed 1–3 (PDF 3–5),5–6 (PDF 7–8); ArticlesV–VI and approval/certification read directly.
independentOriginalSpotChecks.finding: Article V provides an elected district council and council-selected executive committee accountable to it. Article VI expressly recognizes earlier tribal powers. Printed 6 records July 3 ratification, July 29 approval recommendation and August 4,1937 federal approval. The profile correctly distinguishes ratification and approval and gives only a historical example.
